text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] P1 - tail latency spike observed in runtime-prod-canary after recent rollout. Auto-detection triggered at 09:34 UTC. Links: <metrics> <runbook/latency>
oncall-maria: Acknowledged. I'm taking pager. Any idea which change is in the canary?
sahil: That was my canary. Rolled rev abc1f9 -> introduced kernel-selection heuristics + microbatch window change. Started at 09:30, 20% traffic.
lina: Metrics snapshot: p99 jumped from 120ms -> 1.2s, throughput down ~35% on canary nodes. Kernel fallback rate spiked.
ken: seeing many "kernel_fallback=true" logs and batch_sizing errors, looks like new kernels are failing at certain sequence lengths.
ops_tan: Reproduced a small locally: when sequence_len distribution has tails > 1024 the quant kernel path falls back and stalls batching.
sahil: Ok. I'm going to flip the feature flag for kernel-selection to OFF for canary. If that doesn't help we can kill the entire rollout.
deploy-bot: runbook:feature-flag-toggle sahil toggled flag "kernel_selection_v2" -> OFF for service=runtime-prod-canary (action id: ff-8921).
customer-success-beth: Heads up: support queue got 3 escalations, customers report slow responses and timeouts for long prompts. Starting triage.
oncall-maria: Good. After the flag flip, let's watch p50/p95/p99 for 5 minutes. If no improvement, coordinate rollback. Who can /rollback?
sahil: I can trigger rollback. Holding for 2m to confirm.
lina: Slight improvement at +90s: p99 down to ~620ms from 1.2s, throughput still ~20% below baseline. Kernel_fallback events reduced but not gone.
ken: Sharing a short log excerpt: ```
2026-03-17T09:35:12Z runtime[pid=4721] ERROR kernel_select: fallback_to_generic=true reason="batch_mismatch" rev=abc1f9
2026-03-17T09:35:13Z runtime[pid=4721] WARN latency_ms p99=1240 p50=38
2026-03-17T09:35:50Z runtime[pid=4721] ERROR batcher: microbatch_window=20ms exceeded, queue_depth=14
```
ops_tan: Given partial improvement, recommend routing canary traffic to older kernel variant and start a rollback if routing doesn't stabilize throughput within 3m.
sahil: Initiating canary rollback to 0% now. deploy-bot please run the rollback job.
deploy-bot: rollback job started by sahil -> rolling canary down from 20% to 0% over 2m. (job id: rb-5543). Progress: 20% -> 8% -> 0%
oncall-maria: Monitor customer impact and update status page. Beth, keep me posted on incoming tickets.
customer-success-beth: Noted. No new P1 complaints, the three we had are being handled; they reported slow attachments/generation timeouts but no data loss.
lina: After rollback to 0% the metrics look back to baseline: p99 ~130ms, throughput normalized. Kernel fallback count returned to baseline.
ken: Root cause hypothesis: kernel-selection heuristic aggressively routed short-batch tails to the new quant kernels which have an edge-case mismatch for mixed sequence batches causing batcher stalls. Will reproduce and add more preflight checks.
oncall-maria: Good work. Let's close the page if no new regressions in 30m. Action items: sahil to open incident ticket + rollback notes, ken to file kernel unit test and preflight, lina to add metric alert thresholds for kernel_fallback spikes, ops_tan to add a safer canary ramp with gating on both p99 and kernel_fallback_rate.
sahil: Creating incident writeup now and will include logs + timing.
ops_tan: Follow-up: add kill-switch playbook entry for future rollouts (a single command to isolate canary).
oncall-maria: Handing off to daytime oncall in 25m, but for now paging cleared. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: rollback completed successfully (rb-5543).
ken: I'll start a minimal repro job and tag the PR w/ test plan.
customer-success-beth: I'll send proactive note to impacted customers summarizing mitigation and ETA for next update.
oncall-maria: End of thread. Page cleared at 09:46 UTC.
